about: Words and lines Pavo's prompt filter refuses (E128). A native-route line holding one of `words`, or a line whose words digest is in `lines` (appended by pavo_native.record_block when the adapter reads back PAVO_PROMPT_BLOCKED), is voiced by the pinned Kokoro voice instead (owner 27/10 R4). Reason codes only, never the filter's text.
evidence: evidence/pavo/20261027/native-audio-probe/probe.json (PR #473): s-c4-adam (Genesis 3:10) twice and g-c4-naked (Genesis 3:11) read back PromptSafetyBlocked text_rejected_porn, nothing deducted; the adapter reported `incomplete`
